entries.title: The Catalogue of Lost Things
entries.summary: Some favorite passages from the many new releases that wound up on our desks this July and August.

entries.title: James Joyces’s Baby Impressions and Other “Awkward Pleasures” of Literary Biography
entries.summary: “I believed I had a fair understanding of W. G. Sebald until I read his biography and saw the black-and-white snapshot of him as a young man standing thigh-deep in a river, topless in wet jeans with a deep tan, defined muscles, and a dagger in his hand.”

entries.title: In the Studio with Chad Fore, the Writer Behind “Lil Spooky”
entries.summary: “‘What are they rapping about?’ ‘Well, devil worship.’”
